text: Sicily Sewell (born October 1, 1985) is an American chef, restaurateur, television producer, and actress, often credited simply as Sicily in film or television. Following the birth of two daughters, she transitioned into a career in restaurateur. Born in Pontiac, Michigan, Sewell experienced a parental divorce and, along with her mother and three brothers, moved to California where other family members lived; one of her brothers was born after the relocation. She grew up in Los Angeles. As an adult, she attended the Hollywood campus of Le Cordon Bleu College of Culinary Arts. At age eight, she made a television appearance in an Emmy Award-winning episode of Sesame Street and later portrayed "Young Aisha" in two-part episodes of Mighty Morphin Power Rangers' Season 2 and in the 10-part miniseries Mighty Morphin Alien Rangers. She starred as young Diana in the 1998 miniseries Mama Flora's Family and as Angela Bassett's niece in the film How Stella Got Her Groove Back. For four seasons, she played Spirit Jones, the best friend of Breanna Barnes (played by Kyla Pratt), in the sitcom One on One; she was released from the series on June 20, 2005, when it was nine episodes away from syndication. In August 2005, she appeared in the Lifetime original movie Fighting the Odds: The Marilyn Gambrell Story alongside Ernie Hudson, Edwin Hodge, and Jami Gertz. Sewell's family has a long tradition of skilled cookery, and she has stated she is happier as a chef and restaurateur than as an actor. In 2010, while enrolled at the Hollywood campus of Le Cordon Bleu, she interned at the Los Angeles Times' Test Kitchen and later graduated with honours. She and her mother co-own a soul food restaurant called Pinky and Red's in Berkeley, California, and in late 2019, she was hired as chef of the high-profile restaurant Colors in New York City. In a 2022 interview with Comedy Hype, Sewell came out as gay, revealing that although she remains in the closet with her One on One castmates, she was open about her attraction to women to her close friends.
